summary: Script has strong bash practices (shebang, set -euo pipefail, error handling, input validation). Workflow has clean structure (minimal permissions, proper job dependencies, explicit exit code handling). Critical gap: delivery missing ci-input/ fixtures and test/license_checker.bats that workflow references—workflow cannot run as-is. Act test harness only covers 2 cases with repetitive assertion blocks (should be parameterized). Complex regex in parse_pip_manifest (line 37–44) undocumented. Undocumented --parse-only flag in main script.
